title: Arathi Highlands
body: The Arathi Highlands are rolling green hills and scattered pines, and the birthplace of the first human nation: here Thoradin united the tribes into the Empire of Arathor and raised Strom, its first capital. Those days are long gone. Stromgarde, the kingdom that grew from Strom, lies in ruins, carved up between its last loyal soldiers, the outlaws of the Syndicate and the Boulderfist ogres. The Horde holds Hammerfall in the northeast, the Witherbark trolls press everyone, and beneath the hills a voice begs to be set free.

title: The Circles of Binding
body: Four rings of standing stones lie scattered across the highlands, the strongest of them near the ruins of Stromgarde. Each holds a Stone of Binding, and together they pin something deep beneath the earth. Elementals of flame, water, thunder and stone keep watch over them, and a Keystone stands within the inner ring as a final lock.

title: Stromgarde Keep
body: Once Strom, the first capital of humankind, Stromgarde was long the seat of the Trollbane kings. Now it is a ruin and a battlefield. Prince Galen Trollbane's militia holds the quarter around the chapel where King Thoras lies entombed, the Syndicate commands the inner keep, and the Boulderfist ogres have taken the old mage district and its tower. None of the three can drive out the others.

title: Faldir's Cove
body: On the rugged southern coast lies Faldir's Cove, named, it seems, for Faldir, the descendant of Thoradin who led his followers away from Arathor to found Stormwind. Today pirates of the Blackwater Raiders camp beside the water, marooned since the sea fell away beneath their ships on the reef offshore, where Daggerspine naga guard sunken stonework.

title: Refuge Pointe
body: Refuge Pointe, in the heart of the highlands, is the last stronghold of the kingdom of Stromgarde. When the city fell, the remnants of its army withdrew here, and under Captain Nials they have sworn not to leave until the king's banner flies over Stromgarde once more. Their ranks thin while the enemy's swell, and help from Southshore must pass through Syndicate country.

title: Hammerfall
body: Hammerfall stands on ground the orcs remember with bitterness. After the Second War this was one of the largest internment camps, where captured orcs were held behind wood and steel. Thrall and Orgrim Doomhammer stormed it to free them, and there a knight charged Doomhammer from behind and ran him through, a mortal wound. When the Horde returned, it raised an outpost on the ruins and named it for the fallen warchief.

parts.body: An old orc of Hammerfall, Gor'mul, was a prisoner here that day and saw his warchief fall. Left behind when the others escaped, he wandered alone and without hope for years until the Horde returned.

title: Witherbark Village
body: In the southeast of the highlands lies Witherbark Village, home of the forest trolls who have been sworn enemies of Stromgarde for generations, as the forest trolls were enemies of Arathor of old. Their shadow hunters earn a special knife in their rites of passage, and the tribe has made common cause with the Boulderfist ogres to drive the Horde from Hammerfall.

title: Prince Galen Trollbane
body: Galen Trollbane is the son of King Thoras Trollbane and heir to a kingdom in ruins. With his father dead, he leads the militia that holds part of Stromgarde from a chapel beside the Sanctum, where Thoras lies entombed with the ancestral sword Trol'kalar. The sigils that unseal the tomb were divided among the survivors, and Galen keeps one on his own person.

parts.body: His guards could not save him. He was cut down in his chapel beside his father's tomb, and the defenders of Stromgarde lost the prince who led them.

title: Myzrael
body: Myzrael calls herself a princess of the earth, held captive deep beneath the Arathi Highlands by the giants. Her only voice in the world above comes through crystal shards in the northern hills, and through them she pleads for rescue, stirring a feeling of warmth and safety in all who listen, and asks only for help in breaking the wards that pin her down.

parts.body: With the last lock broken she cried that she was free, free to gather strength hidden from the giants, and promised to call on her rescuer again when she was ready to rise.
sources: quest 642 description

parts.body: Her friends were waiting: cultists of the Twilight's Hammer, who call Myzrael their Lady and mean to see her return, though the scroll that could summon her was stolen by a renegade of their order.
sources: quest 642 description

parts.body: Called up before her power had returned, she named her rescuer a fool and attacked, and was beaten. Her own shackles now bind her beneath the Shards, and the crystals that once soothed every listener carry only her ill will.
